title: Plural 4: Feminine and Neuter Genitive (zero ending and -ей)
titleRussian: Множественное число 4: Родительный падеж женского и среднего рода
description: The feminine and neuter genitive plural relies on a different mechanic. Hard fem -а and hard neuter -о drop their vowel to a zero ending, often inserting a fleeting -о- or -е- to break a consonant cluster. Soft fem -ь and soft neuter -е take -ей. The 3rd-declension feminine line takes -ей as well.
descriptionRussian: Родительный падеж множественного числа женского и среднего рода работает иначе. Твёрдые основы (книга, окно) теряют гласную и получают нулевое окончание, часто с беглой -о- или -е-. Мягкие основы (тетрадь, море) получают -ей.
intro: The other half of the genitive, and it works on a completely different principle. Instead of adding an ending, hard feminine and neuter nouns take one away, leaving a bare stem. When that leaves a cluster nobody can pronounce, Russian slips a vowel back in. So the ending here is nothing at all, and the difficulty is entirely in what happens to the stem.
rules: Hard feminine -а drops to a zero ending: книга → книг, мама → мам, школа → школ, улица → улиц.
Hard neuter -о drops to a zero ending: место → мест, дело → дел, слово → слов.

When the resulting stem ends in a consonant cluster, a fleeting vowel is inserted to make it pronounceable. The fleeting vowel is most often -е- (or stressed -ё-): ручка → ручек, письмо → писем, сестра → сестёр. After a hard cluster like -кн-, the fleeting vowel surfaces as -о-: окно → окон.
Soft feminine -ь (3rd-declension) takes -ей: тетрадь → тетрадей, дверь → дверей, ночь → ночей, площадь → площадей.
Soft neuter -е takes -ей: море → морей, поле → полей.
Triggers are identical to L3: numbers 5+, много / мало / несколько, нет, prepositions без / у / для / из / от. Only the ending depends on the gender.
examples: В библиотеке много книг. (There are many books in the library.) книга → книг, fem -а → zero.
У Лены много ручек. (Lena has many pens.) ручка → ручек, fem -а cluster + fleeting -е-.
В шкафу пять тетрадей. (There are five notebooks in the cupboard.) тетрадь → тетрадей, soft fem -ь + -ей.
В комнате восемь окон. (There are eight windows in the room.) окно → окон, neuter -о cluster + fleeting -о-.
В России много морей. (Russia has many seas.) море → морей, soft neuter -е + -ей.
У этой девочки нет сестёр. (This girl has no sisters.) сестра → сестёр, fem -а cluster + stressed fleeting -ё-.

items.promptEnglish: There are six doctors in the office.
items.hint: Recap from L3: the consonants ж, ш, ч, щ take which gen pl ending?
items.explanation: L3 recap: masculine nouns ending in ж, ш, ч, щ take -ей in the gen pl. Врач → врачей. After numbers 5 and above, the noun goes into the genitive plural; the consonant ч selects the -ей ending.

items.promptEnglish: There are many books in the library.
items.hint: Книга is feminine -а. What is the gen pl ending for hard fem -а stems?
items.explanation: Hard feminine -а stems drop the -а to a zero ending in the gen pl. Книга → книг. The fem rule is the mirror of the masc rule: instead of adding -ов, the feminine drops the vowel.

items.hint: Ручка ends in -ка (consonant cluster чк before -а). What gets inserted?
items.explanation: When the stem ends in a consonant cluster, a fleeting vowel breaks it up. Ручка → ручек, with -е- inserted between ч and к. The same pattern gives девочка → девочек, чашка → чашек, тарелка → тарелок.

items.promptEnglish: There are five notebooks in the cupboard.
items.hint: Тетрадь is 3rd-declension feminine in soft -ь. Soft fem -ь takes which gen pl ending?
items.explanation: Soft feminine -ь (3rd-declension) takes -ей in the gen pl: тетрадь → тетрадей. The same -ей ending also covers дверь → дверей, ночь → ночей, площадь → площадей. Watch for the stem-extension irregulars мать → матерей, дочь → дочерей.

items.promptEnglish: There are eight windows in the room.
items.hint: Окно is neuter -о. The cluster кн forces a fleeting vowel; which one fits a hard stem?
items.explanation: Neuter -о drops to a zero ending. The stem окн- is a consonant cluster, so a fleeting vowel breaks it: окон. The fleeting vowel is -о- here because the surrounding consonants are hard.

items.hint: Море is neuter -е. Soft neuter takes which gen pl ending?
items.explanation: Soft neuter -е takes -ей in the gen pl: море → морей, поле → полей. This mirrors the soft fem -ь pattern (тетрадь → тетрадей). Hard neuter -о drops to zero (окно → окон); soft neuter -е uses the soft ending -ей.

blanks: В этом районе пять _____. (There are five schools in this district.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: After numbers 5 and above, the noun takes the genitive plural. Школа is hard fem -а with no consonant cluster, so the gen pl is simply the bare stem: школ.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: There are many ___ (books) in the library.
minimalPairs.explanation: After много + countable plural, the noun takes the genitive plural. Книги is the plural nominative ('the books' as a subject). Книг is the gen pl with the zero ending characteristic of hard fem -а stems.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: There are many words in this book.
minimalPairs.explanation: After много + countable plural, the noun takes the gen pl. Слово is hard neuter -о, so the gen pl is the zero ending: слов. Слова is the plural nominative or singular genitive (depending on stress); neither fits after много.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: There are no girls in our class.
errorCorrection.explanation: Девочка is a hard feminine -а, so its genitive plural is a zero ending. But the bare stem девочк ends in an unpronounceable cluster -чк, so Russian inserts a fleeting vowel: девочек. After ч the fleeting vowel is -е-, never -о-. Девочк is the trap of dropping -а and stopping there; it cannot be pronounced. The fleeting vowel is the whole point of these cluster nouns.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: There are five bags in the shop.
errorCorrection.explanation: Сумка is a hard feminine -а with a zero genitive plural, but the cluster -мк needs a fleeting vowel to be sayable: сумок. After the hard consonant м the fleeting vowel surfaces as -о- (contrast девочек, where ч forces -е-). Сумк is the bare-cluster trap. The number пять triggers the genitive plural here.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: There are no letters on the table.
errorCorrection.explanation: Письмо is neuter -о with a zero genitive plural, but the cluster -сьм needs a fleeting vowel: писем. The soft sign of письмо is replaced by the inserted -е-, giving писем (not письм). Письм is the bare-cluster trap that a learner produces by dropping -о and stopping. Neuter cluster nouns take the same fleeting vowel treatment as the feminines.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: There are many newspapers at the kiosk.
errorCorrection.explanation: Газета is feminine -а, not masculine, so the masculine -ов ending does not apply. The hard feminine -а genitive plural is a bare zero ending: газет. Газетов is the trap of borrowing the masculine -ов where it does not belong.

Сестра has a zero genitive plural, but the cluster -стр would be unpronounceable at the end, so a fleeting vowel breaks it: сестёр. The fleeting vowel here is the stressed -ё-. Сестр is the bare-stem form without the rescue vowel; it is not Russian.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: There are no words in the magazine.
errorCorrection.explanation: Слово is neuter, not masculine, so it does not take -ов. The neuter -о genitive plural is a zero ending with no cluster to break: слов. Словов is the same over-applied masculine -ов trap as книгов; it is not a real form. When the stem ends in a single consonant, no fleeting vowel is needed: just drop the -о.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: There are five beds in the room.
errorCorrection.explanation: Кровать is 3rd-declension feminine (soft -ь), not masculine, so the -ов ending never applies. The soft feminine -ь genitive plural is -ей: кроватей. Кроватов is the trap of treating a 3rd-declension noun as a hard masculine.

reviewVocab.definition: zero ending; no overt suffix on the noun. Used in the gen pl of hard fem -а (книг) and hard neuter -о (слов) stems.
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'У Лены пять книг' слово 'книг' имеет нулевое окончание.

reviewVocab.definition: fleeting vowel; an -о-, -е-, or stressed -ё- inserted to break a consonant cluster in the gen pl. Examples: ручка → ручек, окно → окон, сестра → сестёр.
reviewVocab.example: В слове 'окон' появляется беглая -о-, чтобы разбить группу согласных.

reviewVocab.definition: the 3rd declension; feminine nouns ending in soft -ь (тетрадь, дверь, ночь). Their gen pl ending is -ей.
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'У Лены пять тетрадей' слово 'тетрадей' стоит в родительном падеже множественного числа третьего склонения.
